column7: Hardening (defense in depth, not a reachable bypass on main: the /api/v1 Authentication middleware already refuses a suspended account at session/PAT validation). Before this change ActivateMFA, DisableMFA and RegenerateMFARecoveryCodes did not call requireActorActive at all; a suspended or inactive human actor was only refused later, by requireReauth's use-time re-check, after the op's own reads. They now call requireActorActive as their first act, before any TOTP, recovery-code or password evaluation or MFA storage read. mfaActiveGuardRefusal re-wraps the refusal as markPermissionDenied(&reauthRejectedError{msg: "invalid code or password"}): the same text as the wrong-credential path (REST writeMFAErr answers it 400 with that safe message, like a wrong credential; no gRPC route), still errors.Is ErrPermissionDenied and ErrReauthRejected. A storage fault (ErrStorageReadUnavailable) propagates unchanged as 503. Proving test TestSuspendedActorRefusedAtEntryPoints is red on main for the three ops (no ErrPermissionDenied before any MFA read); TestMFAOpsRefusalTextMatchesWrongPassword (internal/core/reauth_grant_suspend_test.go) is the regression guard that the refusal text stays identical to the wrong-credential text.
